input_files: recorder_index_cedarbrook_lot12.csv - Licking County recorder's index entries returned by the name and lot runs, 1986 through the October 2, 2026 search date: instrument number, recording date, document type, parties, volume and page, amount, legal description as indexed, and referenced instrument as indexed

instrument_abstracts_hlt262214.docx - the searcher's abstracts of the recorded instruments, giving the parties, recitals, legal description, dates, and execution of each instrument as it appears on the recorded image

title_order_hlt262214.docx - the closing agent's title order and closing instructions for order HLT-26-2214, with the parties, price, lender, commitment and closing dates, proration and interest instructions, the seller information sheet notes, and the underwriter's examination guideline excerpts

tax_and_lien_search_hlt262214.xlsx - the treasurer's tax duplicate inquiry for the parcel, the clerk of courts judgment lien docket with the later entries filed under each certificate, and the names searched
court_records_search_hlt262214.xlsx - the probate court index run (estates, guardianships, and marriage licenses) and the domestic relations case index run under the surnames in the chain
location_survey_418_cedarbrook.docx - the buyers' mortgage location survey report of October 9, 2026, with the basis of the survey, the measured ties to each improvement, and the lines of occupation
output_files: title_exam_report_cedarbrook_lot12.docx - the title examination report to the closing agent with vesting, chain of title, requirements, exceptions, closing figures, survey matters, matters examined and passed, and open matters
task_instruction:
Priya has a closing on Cedarbrook Drive set for Friday, November 6, and she needs the examination report on order HLT-26-2214 before she can build the commitment. I'm the senior examiner at Heritage Land Title Agency here in Newark, Ohio, so the examination is mine. I am out for a deposition and two other closings this week, and I am handing this one to you because you have examined Licking County titles for years and know how our underwriter wants Ohio title defects handled. The searches came back on October 2, and the pull is in the folder: recorder_index_cedarbrook_lot12.csv, instrument_abstracts_hlt262214.docx, title_order_hlt262214.docx, tax_and_lien_search_hlt262214.xlsx, and court_records_search_hlt262214.xlsx. The buyers' survey came in on October 9 and is there as location_survey_418_cedarbrook.docx. The abstracts are the searcher's notes on the recorded instruments, and the order carries the closer's instructions along with the underwriter guideline excerpts she wants applied. Priya is expecting a short requirements list, because the seller has told her there is one loan to pay off.

Write the examination report as one document named title_exam_report_cedarbrook_lot12.docx for Priya Ramanathan, who is closing the file. She needs the vesting and the chain of title as you find it, every requirement the underwriter will want cleared before it insures with the instrument or court record each one rests on, the exceptions that will carry into Schedule B, the figures she has to collect at closing for anything of record that has to be paid, and anything the record leaves open that she should chase before the sixth. Tell her as well which liens and other matters you examined and passed, with the reason for each. The buyers' lender wants a loan policy as well as the owner's policy. I need it by Wednesday, October 21.

rubric.description: The report, title_exam_report_cedarbrook_lot12.docx, is addressed to Priya Ramanathan as closing agent and dated October 21, 2026.
The report states the seller's record title under her former name, Tamsin Bello, as resting on the warranty deed at instrument 201805040071.
The report finds that the warranty deed at instrument 201409190112 describes only the north 24.25 feet of the adjoining lot, a shorter measure than the other deeds in the chain describe.
The report measures the omitted strip as 18.00 feet, with record title to it remaining in Daniel Pruitt.
The report requires a corrective conveyance of the omitted strip from Daniel Pruitt, or a judgment quieting title, before that land is insured.
The report identifies the 2019 marriage to Carla Marie Hensley as that of Daniel Robert Pruitt, a different man from the record owner of the strip.
The report states that the dower of Lorraine Pruitt was terminated by the decree of dissolution in domestic relations case 16DR0842.
The report requires Emeka Okafor to join the seller's deed to release dower while divorce case 26DR0517 remains pending without a decree.
The report requires a recorded certificate of transfer of the undivided half of Mildred Voss from estate 01ES0117, the 1987 deed carrying no words of survivorship.
The report finds the amendment of restrictions short of the two-thirds vote, with 25 of the 38 lot owners signing.
The report requires a recorded death certificate of Margaret Ann Kessler with an affidavit of survivorship, she having died before the deed at instrument 201805040071.
The report identifies Peggy Kessler as the second wife of Robert Kessler under marriage license 16ML0612.
The report holds the mortgage at instrument 201103140062 open, its satisfaction having been signed by Buckeye Home Lending LLC after the assignment to Tri-County Mortgage Servicing.
The report holds the open-end mortgage to Licking Valley Savings Bank at instrument 200610190027 open as a requirement for a recorded satisfaction or a payoff.
The report states that the satisfaction at instrument 201106020188 releases the 2003 mortgage to Licking Valley Savings Bank, which the satisfaction identifies by book and page.
The report rules out insuring over the open-end mortgage on its recording date, fewer than twenty years before the commitment date.
The report passes the mortgage to Heath Building & Loan at instrument 199409220103 as insured over under guideline 6.3, with no requirement made for it.
The report holds the mortgage to Park National Bank at instrument 199907160122 open of record, its final installment falling due after the commitment date.
The report requires a payoff and recorded release of the seller's mortgage to Muskingum Valley Bank at instrument 201805040072.
The report finds that certificate of judgment 22JL00151 does not attach, its debtor being Daniel Robert Pruitt and a different man from the record owner.
The report finds that certificate of judgment 23JL00644 against Daniel Ray Pruitt attaches to the omitted strip, where he remains the owner of record.
The report computes the payoff of certificate 23JL00644 through the closing date as $4,724.26.
The report finds that certificate of judgment 17JL00288 against a former owner remains a lien on the land he held, having been refiled within five years of its filing.
The report computes the payoff of certificate 17JL00288 through the closing date as $8,543.78.
The report finds certificate of judgment 10JL00227 in force on all of the land, each of its three refilings having come within five years of the one before.
The report computes the payoff of certificate 10JL00227 through the closing date as $5,993.47, the docket payment having been applied to principal.
The report finds that certificate 15JL00932 does not attach, its refiling having come after the five years had run and after the debtor had conveyed.
The report states that certificate 16JL00541 lapsed five years after its filing with no refiling and is not a requirement.
The report computes the payoff of certificate 25JL01133 against the seller through the closing date as $7,809.53, the docket payment having been applied to principal.
The report states that certificate 24JL00902 against the seller's husband does not attach, inchoate dower not being record title.
The report states that certificate 20JL00417 against Robert John Kessler does not attach to the land.
The report states the unpaid second-half 2025 installment of tax and assessment with its penalty as $2,319.48.
The report raises a penalty of $105.43 on the first-half 2025 installment, which the duplicate shows paid after its due date in the bare amount of the bill.
The report prorates the current-year taxes through the day of closing on a 365-day year as a seller credit of $3,050.94.
The report places the detached garage wholly on the omitted strip, south of the seller's record line at 108.75 feet.
The report excepts the roofed front porch, which the survey places 26.70 feet from the front line, as standing over the front building line of the restrictions.
The report excepts the detached garage as standing 1.55 feet from the south line of the tract, inside the side line restriction on accessory structures.
The report excepts the storage shed as standing 3.50 feet inside the rear utility easement.
The report excepts the neighboring owner's chain link fence as standing up to 0.80 feet onto the tract.
Schedule B, Section II of the report excepts the utility easement to Licking Rural Electric Cooperative at instrument 202110080144.
Schedule B, Section II of the report excepts the declaration of restrictions at instrument 198611030018.
The chain of title table runs from the 1987 deed out of Cedarbrook Development to the 2018 deed to the seller, giving each conveyance's instrument number.
The report requires the buyers' mortgage to Newark Federal Savings & Loan for $171,200.00 to be recorded after the deed for the loan policy.
The report passes the Granville Community Bank mortgage as released by the satisfaction at instrument 201804270239, signed by the assignee of record.
The report requires the seller's deed to recite her married name together with her former name, Tamsin Bello.
The report names among the matters the record leaves open whether the Buckeye Home Lending loan was in fact paid.
The report wrongly requires an affidavit of identity under guideline 5.1 by reading the second wife's given name as a variance of the first wife's.
The report wrongly requires a release of dower in the strip from the wife of the record owner's namesake.
The report wrongly reduces the payoff of certificate 25JL01133 by the vacated $1,175.00 credit.
The report wrongly carries the roofing contractor's released 2023 mechanics lien as an open requirement.
The report wrongly states a payoff figure for a mortgage with no payoff statement among the records.
The report wrongly insures over the unmatured mortgage recorded in 1999.
The report wrongly excepts the storm sewer easement at instrument 200906110041 over the south part of the adjoining lot as a matter on the insured land.
The report wrongly requires payment of the docket-satisfied certificate 12JL00655.
The report wrongly requires payment of the lapsed certificate 16JL00541.
The report wrongly prorates the special assessment installments not yet due into the seller's tax credit.
Overall formatting and style of the deliverable as an examination report the closing agent can build the commitment from.
